prompt:
Independently audit this contract against the indexed spec only.
Check (1) every spec segment mapped to a rule or marked unrelated/missing, (2) absent verbatim
evidence without uncertain, (3) contradictions between rule fields and examples, (4) plausible
alternative semantics with a concrete distinguishing chronological input sequence, and (5) derive
outputs for any explicit spec waveform/table/examples and compare. Report distinct material issues.
Return JSON {coverage:{Sxx:[rule IDs or "unrelated"/"missing"]},issues:[
{issue_id,rule_id (or "global"),type:"coverage"|"grounding"|"consistency"|"ambiguity"|"spec_example",
severity:"high"|"medium"|"low",detail,spec_evidence (verbatim spec or ""),alternative,sequence}]}.
Keep any deliberation brief and use short issue descriptions so the entire JSON fits. For ambiguity
the alternative must be specific; sequence must be a nonempty list of complete
width-valid nonclock input rows (optional mid) using the contract ports. For other types alternative
can be an empty string and sequence can be []. Code and prose outside JSON are not needed.
Indexed specification:
{"S01":"For each bit in a 32-bit vector, capture when the input signal changes from 1 in one clock cycle to 0 the next. \"Capture\" means that the output will remain 1 until the register is reset (active high synchronous reset)."}
Contract JSON:
{"ports":{"inputs":{"reset":1,"in":32},"outputs":{"out":32},"clock":"clk"},"states":[{"name":"out","meaning":"32-bit sticky capture register; out[i] becomes 1 after in[i] is sampled as 1 in one cycle and 0 in the next, and remains 1 until synchronous reset.","update_time":"posedge after sampling reset and in; reset has priority and sets all bits to 0","update_during_reset":true},{"name":"prev_in","meaning":"32-bit previous sampled value of in, used to detect per-bit 1-to-0 transitions; it tracks in on every posedge including reset cycles.","update_time":"posedge after sampling in","update_during_reset":true}],"rules":[{"id":"reset_clear","outputs":["out"],"condition":"reset == 1; on this posedge out becomes 32'd0.","edge":"posedge","visible":"same_cycle","priority":2,"spec_quote":"active high synchronous reset","uncertain":false,"example":{"vectors":[{"reset":0,"in":1},{"reset":0,"in":0},{"reset":1,"in":0}],"expected":[{"out":0},{"out":1},{"out":0}]}},{"id":"capture_fall","outputs":["out"],"condition":"reset == 0 and exists i such that prev_in[i] == 1 and in[i] == 0; for each bit j, out[j] becomes 1 if prev_in[j] == 1 and in[j] == 0, else out[j] holds its previous value.","edge":"posedge","visible":"same_cycle","priority":1,"spec_quote":"capture when the input signal changes from 1 in one clock cycle to 0 the next","uncertain":false,"example":{"vectors":[{"reset":0,"in":1},{"reset":0,"in":0},{"reset":0,"in":0}],"expected":[{"out":0},{"out":1},{"out":1}]}},{"id":"hold_state","outputs":["out"],"condition":"reset == 0 and for all i, not (prev_in[i] == 1 and in[i] == 0); for each bit j, out[j] holds its previous value.","edge":"posedge","visible":"same_cycle","priority":0,"spec_quote":"output will remain 1 until the register is reset","uncertain":false,"example":{"vectors":[{"reset":0,"in":1},{"reset":0,"in":0},{"reset":0,"in":1},{"reset":0,"in":1}],"expected":[{"out":0},{"out":1},{"out":1},{"out":1}]}}],"reset":{"kind":"sync","name":"reset","active":"high","values":{"out":0},"first_released_cycle":"the first posedge that samples reset == 0; under the current contract, a 1 sampled while reset is high can pair with a 0 after release and set out.","candidates":["prev_in tracks in on every posedge including reset cycles; a 1 sampled while reset is high followed by 0 after release captures (current behavior)","prev_in is cleared or ignored while reset is high, so reset-cycle history cannot cause capture after release"]}]}
